summary: No-code builder for website and WhatsApp AI agents and chatbots, with a lasting free plan to launch a first agent.

pricing.details: Official prices already in euro for customers in the EU (non-EU list prices, in the original currency, stay in the official notes and are not converted for display). Free 0 € forever, no card — 100 chats/month, no AI chats included, 1 seat, full builder and templates, WhatsApp only with a test number. Starter 40 €/month, or 32 €/month billed annually — 500 chats/month (0.05 € per extra chat), 100 AI chats, 2 seats, basic integrations and power-ups. Professional 100 €/month, or 80 €/month billed annually — 2,500 chats/month (0.05 € per extra chat), 300 AI chats, 3 seats, no Landbot branding, essential integrations, live chat support; WhatsApp with your own number +100 € per month. Business is custom (talk to sales). Promo: official BLACK NOVEMBER banner — “Pay 6, get 12 on selected annual plans, applied automatically”. The figures above are the regular list prices, not that promotion.
